title: Tristhali Yatra Guide — Gaya, Kashi & Prayagraj Ancestral Pilgrimage
metaDescription: Complete guide to Tristhali Yatra covering Gaya Pind Daan, Kashi Vishwanath Shradh, and Prayagraj Triveni Sangam Tarpan. Package options, itinerary, and rules.
author: Acharya Pandit V. K. Gayawal
summary: Tristhali Yatra is the most revered ancestral pilgrimage circuit in Sanatana Dharma, combining the sacred triad of Prayagraj (Sangam Tarpan), Kashi (Manikarnika Shradh), and Gaya (Vishnupad Pind Daan).
content:
In Vedic tradition, Tristhali Setu (The Bridge of Three Holy Seats) prescribes a complete pilgrimage circuit across three sacred cities: **Prayagraj** (where rivers converge), **Kashi** (where Lord Shiva grants Taraka Mantra), and **Gaya** (where Lord Vishnu grants final Pinda Mukti).

### The Sacred Order of Tristhali Yatra
1. **Prayagraj (Triveni Sangam)**: Pilgrims perform Veni Daan, hair tonsure (Kshaur karma), and Sangam Tarpan at the confluence of Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati.
2. **Kashi (Varanasi)**: Rites at Manikarnika Ghat, Ganga Pujan, and darshan of Lord Kashi Vishwanath.
3. **Gaya (Vishnupad Dhaam)**: The climax of the pilgrimage where official Pind Daan, Phalgu Tarpan, and Akshayvat Suphal occur under Gayawal Purohits.

sections.heading: Ideal Duration & Travel Itinerary for Tristhali Yatra
sections.body: A standard Tristhali Yatra requires 5 to 7 days. Pitraya provides complete luxury Innova transport connecting Prayagraj ➔ Varanasi (Kashi) ➔ Gaya with pre-booked hotels and local Pandits in all 3 cities.

sections.heading: Budget & Cost Estimates for Family Packages
sections.body: Private 5-day Tristhali Yatra packages start at ₹35,000 for couples and ₹55,000 for families including private AC vehicle, 3-star Sattvik hotels, and all priest Dakshina.

faqs.question: Can Tristhali Yatra be performed in reverse order?
faqs.answer: Vedic texts recommend starting at Prayagraj, progressing to Kashi, and culminating at Gaya for optimal spiritual sequence.

faqs.question: Does Pitraya manage priest coordination in Kashi and Prayagraj too?
faqs.answer: Yes, Pitraya provides verified Teerth Purohits in Prayagraj Sangam, Varanasi Manikarnika, and Gayawal Pandits in Gaya.
